content: latexmk supports -outdir/-auxdir; MiKTeX implements -aux-directory natively, latexmk emulates otherwise. latexmk is a Perl script: locally verified it runs from Git Bash (uses /usr/bin/perl) with -lualatex -outdir=out. From PowerShell Perl may not be on PATH, so a Python build driver calling lualatex directly (-output-directory) avoids the Perl dependency.
